activity.notes: The Treaty of Fontainebleau of 11 April 1814 explicitly created Elba as a separate principality to be possessed by Napoleon in full sovereignty and property while allowing him to retain the imperial title. ATLAS therefore records Elba as a genuine separate sovereign Activity, not merely an exile location. The Activity ends on 26 February 1815 when Napoleon left Elba to return to France for the Hundred Days.
